query:
SELECT id, name, phone, email, stage, followUpDate, createdAt
FROM leads
WHERE name LIKE '%Sarah%Sahota%'
   OR name LIKE '%Sharanpreet%'
   OR name LIKE '%Jaskaran%'
   OR name LIKE '%Vitek%'
   OR name LIKE '%Vishal%kumar%'
   OR name LIKE '%Sujeet%'
   OR name LIKE '%Balwant%'
   OR name LIKE '%Tarunjot%'
   OR name LIKE '%Henry%Wang%'
ORDER BY createdAt DESC;
